messages.subject: Time recording - February narratives outstanding
messages.plaintextBody:
Hi James,

Our records show 14.5 hours unposted for the period ending 28 February, and several narratives still marked 'TBC'. Please complete your time and narratives by close of play Wednesday so we can run the month-end WIP report and prepare draft bills.

Thanks,
Accounts
